subject.title: Add high-contrast mode for inactive displays

question: Should CodexBar permanently expose and support an opt-in attributed-title renderer to improve readability on inactive displays?
rationale: This creates persisted configuration and localized UI for a best-effort workaround to system-controlled dimming, so product acceptance cannot be inferred from technical correctness alone.

options.title: Accept the opt-in renderer
options.body: Keep the default-off compatibility boundary and merge after inspectable multi-display proof covers the relevant status-item states.

options.title: Decline permanent settings surface
options.body: Retain only the standard AppKit renderer and close the PR and linked request as outside the desired product surface.

recommendation.title: Accept the opt-in renderer
recommendation.body: Keep the default-off compatibility boundary and merge after inspectable multi-display proof covers the relevant status-item states.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent controller ownership and merger history make steipete the strongest available owner for the permanent menu bar settings decision.
